content: The TED guidelines on tuberculosis focus on rapid diagnostics for the detection of tuberculosis. The Guideline Development Group (GDG) consists of 160 members with expertise in various areas related to tuberculosis. Nguyen Viet Nhung specializes in tuberculosis program management and is associated with the Western Pacific Region. He is male. Elisabetta Walters has expertise in pediatric tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment and is associated with the African Region. She is female. Yanlin Zhao is an expert in tuberculosis program management and is also associated with the Western Pacific Region. He is male. The GDG is a part of the World Health Organization (WHO), which is responsible for developing these guidelines.
